text:
maria: Heads-up — load test on longctx (100k tokens) shows continuous KV cache growth on MI250X nodes, not seen on H100. Perf alert firing during steady inference. Repro attached below.

perf-bot: Alert KV_CACHE_GROWTH for cluster prod-inference-mi250x (avg growth 12MB/min over 2h) :warning:

devon: can you drop traces? kernel selection logs + page-fault / pagetable traces pls

maria: quick repro command i used:
```
export LR=1
export CONTEXT=100000
./tools/run_infer.sh --model pagedattn-test --seq 32 --batch 8 --longctx $CONTEXT --profile kv --arch mi250x
```
Log excerpt (trimmed):
[2026-03-18 14:12:01] kvcache: alloc page 0x7f.. size 64k for keyslot 12345
[2026-03-18 14:12:12] kvcache: pagetable: lazy_alloc branch taken, new subpage-count=8
[2026-03-18 14:12:12] kvcache: evict candidate found but eviction failed (owner mismatch) -> leaving entry mapped
[2026-03-18 14:12:13] kvcache: growth rate now 11.8 MB/min

aj: hmm owner mismatch on evict is a red flag. Which kernel path used for pagetable walk? MI driver shows fallback to threaded/page-walk kernel instead of atomic GPU walk in a few traces. Could be ordering.

kai: I ran the same repro on H100, no growth. On MI250x we hit lazy_alloc frequently. Hypothesis: lazy_alloc creates subpages on first reference but page table eviction assumes canonicalized owner==0 causing stale owners to remain and prevent reuse.

olga: also check commit 3b2a9ef (worker/alloc: change page-ownership update) — that touched owner write ordering. @maria can you run with RT_TRACE=pagetable and upload the trace?

maria: pasted trace snippet and perf counters:
```
kv_page_allocs: 75643
kv_page_evictions_failed: 324
kv_pt_lazy_allocs: 75210
kv_pt_owner_updates: 0
```

devon: owner_updates==0 — sounds like owner write isn't happening on MI250x path. That would explain evict failures + fragmentation. Likely missing memory fence/ordering after owner write in the pagetable update kernel.

aj: quick experiment — added an atomicExch(owner, worker_id) + threadfence in the update kernel locally, re-ran short repro on MI box. Reduced growth dramatically in first 30m. I'll run longer.

luca: also saw TLB invalidation skipped on some codepaths in previous logs; if owner stays nonzero eviction won't reclaim and reuse can't coalesce -> fragmentation and longctx memory growth.

maria: aj's atomicExch+fence patch preliminary numbers: growth -> 0.2 MB/min (was ~12 MB/min). Need full regression test.

devon: plan/action items:
- create minimal reproducer script and CI job that runs on MI (owners: maria, aj) — target: EOD
- bisect commits in worker/alloc around 3b2a9ef to find regressing change (owner: devon)
- run patched kernel on H100/RTX stack to confirm no behavior change (owner: kai)
- add unit + integration test for owner write ordering in pagetable update kernel; land patch with kernel memory fence (owner: olga)

maria: I'll open issue and attach traces/commands and initial patch link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
